overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused, highly engaged social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content centers around computational social science, disinformation research, software tools like CooRnet, and academic opportunities, resonating strongly with specialized academic and professional audiences.

contentThemes.description: Announcements regarding new papers, research grants, and studies on information operations and coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Updates on analytical software tools like CooRnet and discussions on computational research methods.
Posts recruiting postdoctoral researchers and sharing PhD opportunities in computational social science.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Bluesky to capitalize on high relative engagement rates.
Include visual assets (infographics, diagrams, or paper summary images) to boost engagement across all platforms.
Cross-promote major announcements simultaneously across all platforms to maximize total reach.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest engagement rate relative to follower count, with strong amplification via reposts on academic and research content.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a dedicated niche audience interested in technical updates (e.g., CooRnet release) and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the highest total volume of likes and comments, making it the most effective platform for career announcements, grants, and recruitment.
